html:
Experiencing and enjoying delicious dishes on a cruise is one of the most interesting things for tourists who want to explore and enjoy a lively vacation, with delicious and attractive dishes, including traditional and modern dishes, will bring tourists the most perfect vacation in Ha Long.

On cruises in Ha Long, there are Asian and European style dishes, with breakfast, lunch, dinner such as buffet, premium set menu, BBQ party, dinner in the room.

For breakfast, diners often choose dishes such as: bread, fried eggs, pho, vermicelli, rice rolls, sticky rice, porridge, fresh fruit, juice, tea and coffee, etc.

For lunch and dinner, diners will enjoy dishes such as: pork, beef, chicken, fish, seafood, stir-fried vegetables, fried noodles, mixed rice, steamed rice, grilled dishes, European dishes such as steak, pasta, pizza, and desserts such as cakes, ice cream, fruit… prepared by talented chefs to bring irresistible delicious flavors.

Drinks on the Ha Long cruise include wines, spirits, cocktails, beer, soft drinks, fruit juices, tea and coffee…

When enjoying the buffet on the cruise, visitors can choose for themselves, with a variety of dishes for visitors to choose from, and there are many different dishes that bring different delicious flavors, depending on the preferences of each diner.

If you are a travel lover, then join Vietlook to experience Ha Long cruise, it will be one of the great experiences for tourists.

Especially when talking about Ha Long, tourists cannot ignore the fresh seafood dishes such as: Lobster, crab, snail, clam, oyster, fish … seafood here is processed very fresh.

So to experience the cruise not only brings tourists comfortable moments, watching the poetic scenery from the cruise, but tourists also enjoy delicious dishes, and there are many set menus for tourists to choose from to suit their preferences and needs. Coming here, tourists must have their own answer such as what to eat on Ha Long cruise, through this article will help tourists’ cruise trip to be the most perfect during their vacation.
